top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Allow resident to participate in the development and implementation of his or her person-centered plan of care.
Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.
Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Develop and maintain an Emergency Preparedness Program (EP).
Address patient/client population and determine types of services needed.
Establish policies and procedures including evacuation.
Have stairways and smokeproof enclosures used as exits that meet safety requirements.
Install smoke barrier doors that can resist smoke for at least 20 minutes.
Have elevators that firefighters can control in the event of a fire.
